verdict.rationale: Postman offers CLI and API hooks that let collections run automatically in CI/CD pipelines (postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19, postman-probe-6), which enables background automation, but this is traditional scheduled/CI automation rather than autonomous AI-driven agent behavior. Agent Mode (postman-docs-8) is an interactive assistant, not a background autonomous process, and no evidence of persistent, self-triggering agent workflows was found.
